import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'is_takeaway' to a more descriptive categorical variable
df['is_takeaway_status'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})

# Calculate total sales by product and takeaway status
sales_by_product_takeaway = df.groupby(['product', 'is_takeaway_status'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Sort products by total sales for better readability
sales_by_product_takeaway['Total'] = sales_by_product_takeaway.sum(axis=1)
sales_by_product_takeaway = sales_by_product_takeaway.sort_values('Total', ascending=False).drop('Total', axis=1)

# Set up the plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

# Create a stacked bar chart
sales_by_product_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=plt.gca(), cmap='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Total Sales by Product and Takeaway Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title='Order Type', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Improve layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
